visual_approval_rule: Passing every blocking gate does not equal visual approval. Human review approves character fidelity.
manual_review_rule: A metric whose target cannot be measured directly from the canonical raster has status manual_review_required and no pass/fail value. Tools must never invent a pass/fail result for it.
overall_rule: FRONT identity gates PASS only when every blocking gate with status calculated passes. Blocking gates with status manual_review_required are listed as open human-review items; they do not produce PASS or FAIL. Secondary metrics are reported but never block.

SilhouetteIoU.formula: count(TargetMask AND RenderMask) / count(TargetMask OR RenderMask), over all 600x800 pixels, both masks binary
SilhouetteIoU.target_source: Targets/Ava_Target_Front_Mask.png (file on disk, checksum in Ava_Target_Manifest_v1.0.json)
SilhouetteIoU.render_source: derive_silhouette() applied to the CAM_CANON_FRONT render

HeadBodyRatioError.formula: abs(render_heads_tall - target_heads_tall) / target_heads_tall, where heads_tall = character_height_px / head_height_px

EyeCenterError.normalization: target head maximum width in pixels (Ava_Geometry_Lock_v1.1.json landmarks.head.max_width_row.pixel_value.width)
EyeCenterError.reported_value: mean of the two per-eye errors
EyeCenterError.pass_rule: max of the two per-eye errors <= threshold

EyeSizeError.formula: per eye: (abs(rw - tw) / tw + abs(rh - th) / th) / 2, with w = xmax - xmin + 1 and h = ymax - ymin + 1 of the eye bounding box
EyeSizeError.reported_value: mean of the two per-eye errors
EyeSizeError.pass_rule: max of the two per-eye errors <= threshold

ListeningModuleCenterError.evaluate_only_when: the target module center is directly measurable from the canonical raster (Geometry Lock entry status == measured)
ListeningModuleCenterError.current_reason: Both modules are partially occluded by hair in Ava_Target_Front.png; full circles are not visible.

ListeningModuleDiameterError.evaluate_only_when: the target module outer diameter is directly measurable from the canonical raster (Geometry Lock entry status == measured)
ListeningModuleDiameterError.current_reason: Both modules are partially occluded by hair in Ava_Target_Front.png; full outer diameters are not visible.

HandScaleError.formula: per hand: (abs(rw - tw) / tw + abs(rh - th) / th) / 2 on the hand bounding box; reported value = mean over hands measured in both images
HandScaleError.note: Tracked and always reported. It does not block progression from FRONT identity fitting in v1.0.

formula_change_policy: Formulas match the definitions used by Ava_RebuildVisualLock_v1.1.py and Ava_Geometry_Lock_v1.1.json metric_definitions. They may not be changed to improve scores. Any change requires a new gate-file version approved by Joe.
